```python
import polars as pl

# Example: Create sample long-format data
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago", "New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago"],
    "temperature": [32, 65, 28, 35, 68, 30]
})

# Reshape from long to wide format
wide_df = df.pivot(
    index="date",
    columns="city",
    values="temperature"
)

print(wide_df)
```
